facts.fact: Ammu's body is found under a blackbark tree with a spear wound under the ribs, in a large coat from Muthu; she has a cord pouch holding a thumb of resin, which Neela keeps.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Neela keep Ammu's resin pouch.

facts.fact: The torn resin scars at Neela's throat and wrists, from the forced resin in ch 27, appear as thin red welts on Devan's throat and wrists via the wound-share.
facts.why: needed because the wound-share is shown working both ways.

facts.fact: Ittan smells of clove oil and has a brick-red wax stain under his thumbnail, explained as rubbing clove on his wife's chest for her cough. His lead cart rides low on the axle with a roped chest under a tarpaulin.
facts.why: needed because it plants clue C19, pointing to genuine council wax (clove oil) and the false-bottomed chest in ch 29.

facts.fact: Ittan arrives at Kettamala on the thirty-ninth day with five carts, the evening before the sealing. Devan lets him pass the gate without a search tonight, so he can be searched on sealing day under border custom.
facts.why: needed because the beat sets Ittan's arrival on day 39 and ch 29 opens on sealing day.

facts.fact: Ittan says he proposed the match himself and is a matchmaker out of vanity.
facts.why: needed because it makes his genial self-description public and fits the established proposal.
